summary.text: Janet Wall is a Democratic state representative for New Hampshire House of Representatives Strafford 11 who has served in the House since 1986, according to Ballotpedia, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Wall earned a B.S. from the University of New Hampshire and did graduate studies there.
Her professional experience includes working as a middle school teacher and as owner of a consulting company.
Wall was a member of the Judiciary Committee in the 2011-2012 session, its vice chair in 2013-2014 and its clerk in 2015, and she also served on the Legislative Ethics Committee.
In the 2019-2020 session she chaired the Legislative Administration Committee, and she was assigned to that committee again in 2021-2024.
In 2022 she was one of three Democrats elected in Strafford 11, and she advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026.
